canonical_statement: For every type equipped with a partial order, there exists a subset that is a chain and is inclusion-maximal among chains.
domain_and_universes: universe u; P : Type u; PartialOrder P; Prop in Lean universe 0
conclusion: There exists c : Set P such that IsMaxChain (fun x y => x <= y) c.
checked_transport_relationship: The alternate expands IsMaxChain to chainhood plus equality with every containing chain; the iff is proved by definitional equality.

killed: removed PartialOrder and replaced the relation by equality
changed the arbitrary carrier to Nat
changed the universal carrier binder to an existential binder
excluded the empty carrier with Nonempty

degenerate_cases: Empty and singleton carriers remain in scope and have kernel-checked maximal-chain boundary witnesses. No Nonempty, finite, completeness, or cardinality hypothesis is present.

alternate_encodings.arbitrary_relation: The stronger maxChain_spec formulation for an arbitrary relation is not the canonical target and receives no statement-phase proof credit.
alternate_encodings.extension_form: The claim that every input chain extends to a maximal chain is not substituted for the bare-existence target.

status_boundary: Exact target elaboration only. Primary-source review, candidate and proof-body audit, obligation registry, theorem proof, trust closure, hermetic replay, and independent acceptance remain open.
